The Heart of aiGrunn

Tech track

aiGrunn started as a developer conference, and the tech track is still its heartbeat. Deep dives into AI architecture, machine learning, MLOps, agents, open-source tooling, security, and the code that actually runs in production. Practitioner-led. No sales pitches. Just the real thing.

📅 November 13, 2026 📍 Groningen city center

Call for proposals

Share your tech expertise with the North.

aiGrunn is a unique stage for developers, researchers, practitioners and thinkers. If you have something worth saying, we want to hear it.

Submit your talk proposal for aiGrunn 2026 and join a lineup of inspiring speakers from across the Netherlands and beyond.

Submit your talk →

Deadline for submissions: 13 October 2026

Submission guidelines
  • Open topics welcome: tech, business, ethics, education, creative AI, public sector
  • No sales pitches. All talks must deliver genuine learning value
  • Technical depth is welcome and appreciated
  • Slots: 30 minutes including Q&A
  • English submissions only
  • All talks are recorded and published on YouTube
